summary: NeuroSense Therapeutics Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 11, 2026, announcing it had been granted a South Korean patent covering the composition of its lead drug candidate, PrimeC, for ALS. The patent, issued by KIPO, extends IP protection in South Korea through 2042, covering the tablet formulation, manufacturing process, and use. This follows similar grants in Japan, Brazil, Australia, and the US. No financial terms, offer, or transaction were disclosed. The filing is a routine patent milestone update, not a special situation event.
